extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen- or going beyond, in file order. The commentary renders transient as the counterpart of immanent; units using it are recorded under that term. No stratum is set: the record does not tie these sections to the September or November 1911 manuscripts.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-521): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read, and transient alone was not searched.

units.claim: On both the empirical and the feeling side Husserl distinguishes immanent and transient intuition, immanent perception and memory being directed at primary contents.
units.quote: On both sides we distinguish immanent and transient intuition.

units.claim: As perception, so the pleasing has its transcendence, since its united intentions point to possible fulfillments.
units.quote: As perception, so the pleasing too has its transcendence.

units.claim: Value in general is a transcendent predicate referring to empirical thingnesses, though immanent valuation, as of a sequence of tones, is also possible.
units.quote: In general value is a transcendent predicate and as such refers to empirical thingnesses.

units.claim: Co-meant-nesses that essentially belong to transcendent thing-perception must be distinguished from other co-meant-nesses that are not thoughts.
units.quote: There presses urgently a need to distinguish sharply between co-meant-nesses that one must essentially count as belonging to transcendent thing-perception

units.claim: An editorial footnote states that transient values constitute themselves through transient apperceptions, as a new unity in valuing on the ground of the thing-unity.
units.quote: and the constitution of the transcendent value is not such that to every thing-appearance a valuation-moment is correlated in the value-consciousness

units.claim: Valuation of things leads back to immanent valuations of intuitive moments; primary values are immanent values.
units.quote: Primary values are immanent values — values that hang directly on something immanent.

units.claim: The primary content constitutes itself as immanent time-unity in inner time-consciousness, with sensible feeling presumably a higher layer over it.
units.quote: The primary content as immanent time-unity constitutes itself in inner time-consciousness

units.claim: The layer of mere affections, where primary contents constitute themselves, has the original a priori form of all immanent experiences, immanent time.
units.quote: Here we have an original and a priori form, the form of all immanent experiences: immanent time.

absences.expected_because: Determinations of value are set against determinations of the thing here, and §4 calls value in general a transcendent predicate referring to empirical thingnesses.
